item.title: Ask HN: Is what Open Commonplace legal?
item.summary: I have been building https://opencommonplace.com/ for over a month. Simply said, it is a platform for people to post book notes and people to read them at the will. That allows you to gain wisdom of books without reading the entire book. As I am building this thing, I was just wondering if putting all the notes online for free really legal? Just wondering!
